## Overview

Aspirin was administered at 81 to 324 mg per day as the active comparator to [apixaban](./apixaban.md) in 5,599 patients with atrial fibrillation who were at increased risk of stroke and for whom vitamin K antagonist therapy was unsuitable ([src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405.md)).
